conventions.batter: right-handed; for a left-hander mirror the clip and use 360 - angle (as in your list)
conventions.angles: your list's convention: 0 = past the bowler, clockwise from above with the bowler at the top; 0-180 off side, 180-360 leg side
conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones, mixamorig: names), skeleton only
conventions.frames: start at 1; contact_frame is the 1-based frame where bat meets ball
conventions.origin: ground, midway between the feet in stance, on the popping crease
conventions.sweet_spot_at_contact_m: where the middle of the bat is at contact, relative to the origin (toward_bowler / toward_off_side / up)
conventions.bat: parent your bat to mixamorig:RightHand with the offset in bat_attachment_reference.fbx; both hands are locked to the handle in every clip
conventions.end_pose: all clips except down-the-track ones end in the batting stance; down-the-track clips end standing ~0.9 m down the pitch
conventions.switch_hits: grip is kept (right hand bottom) so the bat attachment never changes

clips.hands: Bat angled, wrists turn the face late toward fine leg — a deflection, no follow-through.
clips.upper_body: Front shoulder leads, then the chest opens to the leg side as the wrists work.
clips.feet: Back foot walks across to the off side first, front foot follows across — ball is then on the pads.

clips.feet: Back foot walks across to the off side first, front foot follows across — ball is then on the pads.
